## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 39 user-facing changes.
### New
- Middle-click a split title to close the split and all its tabs. - Choose to return saved tabs to their saved URL with one favicon click on Mac.
### Improved
- Choose whether unloaded tabs appear dimmed in Look and Feel settings - Quick Window Space indicators now use balanced padding. - Choose whether Now Playing appears in the sidebar.
### Fixed
- Select webpage text and use controls near the top edge without moving the window - Save the displayed PDF directly from the built-in preview - Quick Windows follow your browser border size while keeping balanced spacing around their controls - Image-converter extensions can save JPEGs repeatedly and keep their image menus after restarting Crest - Return from Picture in Picture to the tab and browser window that started playback - Prevent password manager popups and login-field suggestions from repeatedly reloading webpages - Settings remain fully visible while switching between Spaces.
---
Stable releases are signed, notarized, and ready for everyday use.

## Highlights
### Improved
- Reduce browsing slowdowns from Picture in Picture while still finding videos added as you browse - Check and repair macOS permissions in General settings, verify download folder access, and stop requesting passkey access during ordinary browsing - Reduce pauses during iCloud sync by avoiding repeated sorting work in large browsing histories - Choose which downloaded languages translate automatically and their destination languages in General settings - Gray out language mappings while automatic translation is off and restore their controls when it is enabled
### Fixed
- Translate automatically without pop-ups, turn off translation offers, and manage download and location permissions from site controls without saving accidental blocks - Keep the tab you select while Crest starts instead of returning to the Start Page when extensions finish loading - Keep dragging links into Peek available after following an in-page link
---
